title: A failed project read files a moved task in the Inbox (MOD-560)
prompt: Bug (MOD-560): in the web runtime's task writes (apps/app/src/lib/runtime.web.tasks.ts), when the read that checks a task's project fails (a network or server error), the task is silently filed in the Inbox, and when the read that checks whether a task already exists fails, re-saving it goes down the create path. A failed read is an error, not "nothing there": the write must fail loudly so the caller rolls back and shows the error. Fix it and add regression tests. Don't commit or push.
